const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /tmp/repair_w49_cycle2_validate.lua
+local root = assert(arg[1], "repo root required")
+
+local files = {"mod-tome.lua", "tome-ashes-urhrok.lua"}
+local expected_sources = {
+  ["mod-tome.lua"] = "#{italic}#From the memoirs of Aranion Gawaeil, leader of the Grand Council of Elvala#{normal}#\n\n#{bold}#Chapter One: A Fateful Meeting#{normal}#",
+  ["tome-ashes-urhrok.lua"] = "Behold, the humble wretchling, a testament to our devotion to our Father!",
+}
+
+local function deep_equal(a, b, seen)
+  if type(a) ~= type(b) then return false end
+  if type(a) ~= "table" then return a == b end
+  seen = seen or {}
+  if seen[a] and seen[a] == b then return true end
+  seen[a] = b
+  for k, v in pairs(a) do
+    if not deep_equal(v, b[k], seen) then return false end
+  end
+  for k in pairs(b) do
+    if a[k] == nil then return false end
+  end
+  return true
+end
+
+local function load_records(path)
+  local records = {}
+  local old_t = _G.t
+  _G.t = function(...)
+    local values = {...}
+    values.n = select("#", ...)
+    records[#records + 1] = values
+    return select(2, ...) or select(1, ...)
+  end
+  local chunk, err = loadfile(path)
+  assert(chunk, err)
+  local ok, run_err = pcall(chunk)
+  _G.t = old_t
+  assert(ok, run_err)
+  return records
+end
+
+local function tokens(s, pattern)
+  local out = {}
+  for token in s:gmatch(pattern) do out[#out + 1] = token end
+  return table.concat(out, "\0")
+end
+
+local function positions(s, byte)
+  local out = {}
+  for i = 1, #s do
+    if s:byte(i) == byte then out[#out + 1] = i end
+  end
+  return table.concat(out, ",")
+end
+
+local total_changed = 0
+for _, file in ipairs(files) do
+  local baseline = load_records(root .. "/.ai/task/repair-w49-20260928/baseline/" .. file)
+  local current = load_records(root .. "/" .. file)
+  assert(#baseline == #current, file .. ": record count changed")
+  local changed = 0
+  local matched_expected = false
+  for i = 1, #baseline do
+    local a, b = baseline[i], current[i]
+    if not deep_equal(a, b) then
+      changed = changed + 1
+      assert(a.n == b.n, file .. ": argument count changed at record " .. i)
+      assert(type(a[1]) == "string" and a[1] == b[1], file .. ": source changed at record " .. i)
+      assert(a[1]:find(expected_sources[file], 1, true), file .. ": unexpected changed target at record " .. i)
+      matched_expected = true
+      for j = 1, a.n do
+        if j ~= 2 then assert(deep_equal(a[j], b[j]), file .. ": non-target argument changed at record " .. i) end
+      end
+      assert(type(a[2]) == "string" and type(b[2]) == "string", file .. ": target is not a string")
+      assert(positions(a[2], 10) == positions(b[2], 10), file .. ": LF positions changed")
+      assert(positions(a[2], 9) == positions(b[2], 9), file .. ": TAB positions changed")
+      assert(tokens(a[2], "#%b{}#") == tokens(b[2], "#%b{}#"), file .. ": markup changed")
+      assert(tokens(a[2], "%%[%w%+%-%#%.%d]*[cdeEfgGiouXxqs%%]") == tokens(b[2], "%%[%w%+%-%#%.%d]*[cdeEfgGiouXxqs%%]"), file .. ": printf placeholders changed")
+      assert(tokens(a[2], "<%?=?[^?]*%?>") == tokens(b[2], "<%?=?[^?]*%?>"), file .. ": template markup changed")
+      assert(tokens(a[2], "@[^@]+@") == tokens(b[2], "@[^@]+@"), file .. ": at-markup changed")
+    end
+  end
+  assert(changed == 1 and matched_expected, file .. ": expected exactly one frozen target change")
+  total_changed = total_changed + changed
+  io.write(string.format("PASS %s: baseline=%d current=%d changed_targets=%d\n", file, #baseline, #current, changed))
+end
+assert(total_changed == 2, "expected exactly two changed targets")
+io.write("PASS total changed targets=2; all other records/arguments and LF/TAB/markup/placeholders unchanged\n")
*** End Patch";
const result = await tools.apply_patch(patch);
text(result);
